plants.note: People call it a weed. It is a leaf vegetable that grows whether you ask it to or not. Gloves for the harvest, then it behaves.
A fruit we treat as a vegetable. In this soil it wants heat on the wall and water at the root, not on the leaf.
A succulent that forgives neglect and not kindness. Let the pot dry. The gel is useful; the plant is not a pharmacy.
